description: Call before any cross-chain USDC/USDT transfer. Give the corridor and the amount (and, optionally, baseline_provider: the route you would use; without it Recta compares against lifi, LI.FI's own quote, or across where LI.FI does not apply). Returns, for your route, its estimated total cost in USDC and when it arrives; and, when Recta proves a cheaper route, the saving (a proven lower bound), Recta's 5 % fee, that route's total cost and arrival (the route itself is not named) and execute_via_recta: sign the same request to get the route. No wallet and no address needed (sender, recipient, constraints and gas ceilings are filled when absent and listed in `assumed`; your own sender gives the most exact figure). Stores nothing, charges nothing; 20 a day per IP address.

amount.description: How much of source_asset to send, in whole tokens (not cents, not wei): "100" with USDC means 100 USDC. Minimum 3.5 for stablecoins (about 3.5 USD). No maximum.

baseline_provider.description: Optional: the route you would use without Recta, e.g. lifi, across, stargate_v2, cctp_v2_standard (recta_fit_check lists the ones a corridor admits). Absent: lifi, or across where LI.FI does not apply.

body.description: Alternative to the fields above: the whole evaluation request body (from recta_request_template), as a JSON object.

sender.description: Optional: your own sending address, for the most exact figure.

source_network.description: Lowercase network as in the service descriptor, e.g. base, ethereum, arbitrum.

name: recta_preflight
title: Preflight before a cross-chain transfer: cost, arrival and saving (free, no signature)
